item.title: Openflow 1.1.1
item.description:
• First public release of Openflow: native macOS dictation powered by SpaceXAI Grok models.
  • Hold or tap a shortcut in any app, speak, and get polished text at your cursor.
  • A small bubble above your text cursor shows a live waveform and the words being heard.
  • Corrections ("Monday, no wait, Tuesday"), lists, numbers, and app-aware style for email, chat, documents, and AI prompts.
  • Select text and dictate to edit it by voice.
  • Keeps recording when offline and offers Retry; checks that every paste lands; warns when no audio is detected.
  • Microphone picker, usage dashboard, and a setup assistant that tests each step.
  • Signed over-the-air updates from now on.
  • Not notarized yet: on first launch, approve it in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway.
